artworks.title: Helen Offering Menelaus the Potion of Queen Polydamna
artworks.description: Vouet's Egyptian gift — Helen pours Polydamna's nepenthe for Menelaus, Odyssey IV's drug of forgetfulness from the Nile court.

artworks.title: Menelaus wrestling Proteus
artworks.description: Bonasone's emblem — Menelaus grappling the Old Man of the Sea on Pharos until every shape yields the truth of the returns.

artworks.title: Menelaus and Companions Battling Proteus
artworks.description: MET ivory game piece — Menelaus and his men holding Proteus through his changes, the Pharos ordeal carved for a medieval board.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: The miniseries keeps Menelaus' Egyptian wanderings in the Telemachy frame — Proteus bound, Agamemnon's death learned, Odysseus still missing.

popCulture.title: Helen (play)
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' Egypt romance — the real Helen under Proteus' roof while a phantom fought at Troy, and Menelaus' reunion on the Nile.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.description: Book IV — Menelaus and Helen at Sparta tell Telemachus of Egypt, Pharos, and the Old Man of the Sea who knew every nostos.

popCulture.title: Proteus
popCulture.description: The shape-shifting herdsman of seals — bound by Menelaus on Pharos, he speaks the truth of the returns.
